project(recompiler)

# The program: reads the Blitz module out of the executable, decodes the x86 and writes LLVM IR.
add_library(recompilerlib STATIC)
init_project(recompilerlib)
target_sources(recompilerlib PRIVATE
	"source/module.hpp"
	"source/module.cpp"
	"source/x86.hpp"
	"source/x86.cpp"
	"source/commands.hpp"
	"source/commands.cpp"
	"source/lift.hpp"
	"source/lift.cpp"
)
# The commands are the table of the compiler, so that both always agree.
target_include_directories(recompilerlib PUBLIC "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/source" PRIVATE "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/../code_compiler/source")

add_executable(${PROJECT_NAME})
init_project(${PROJECT_NAME})
set_target_properties(${PROJECT_NAME} PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME blitz-recompiler)
target_sources(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE "source/main.cpp")
target_link_libraries(recompilerlib PUBLIC blitzfront)
target_link_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE recompilerlib)
target_compile_definitions(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE BLITZLLVM_VERSION="${CMAKE_PROJECT_VERSION}")

install(TARGETS ${PROJECT_NAME} RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(TARGETS ${PROJECT_NAME} RUNTIME DESTINATION bin COMPONENT system EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

get_target_property(_SOURCES ${PROJECT_NAME} SOURCES)
source_group(TREE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} FILES ${_SOURCES})
